component.name: Initiative Tracker
component.summary: Track initiative for RPG campaigns (GTK preview)

description.p: Track initiative, health, and scene images for tabletop RPG campaigns. Open a Presenter window on a secondary display for your players while you run combat from the Console.
This is the GTK4 / libadwaita frontend targeting GNOME 50. The Tauri app remains available in parallel during the transition.

screenshot.caption: Console: campaigns, combatants, and Presenter controls
Presenter: player-facing initiative list and scene image

description.p: Initial GTK4 / libadwaita preview with full Console + Presenter feature parity on GNOME 50. Scene images use the document portal and are copied into app data so the Flatpak sandbox stays tight.
